basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old wrestling enthusiast from Chicago who spends my evenings diving into the world of AEW and other wrestling promotions. I work as a graphic designer by day, which allows me to work remotely and flexibly. I have a keen interest in storytelling, character development, and the art of wrestling. In my free time, I enjoy playing basketball, experimenting with new recipes, and attending local wrestling events. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends catching up on wrestling shows and engaging with the wrestling community online.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: My expertise in wrestling comes from years of watching various promotions, reading wrestling news, and participating in online forums. I have no formal education in this field but have self-taught myself through active community engagement and by following wrestling podcasts and YouTube channels.
